async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    import re

    # We'll filter the orders grid to show only canceled orders, increase page size to reduce
    # pagination, then iterate a finite number of pages (parsed from the pagination text)
    # collecting the "Bill to Name" for each canceled order and counting occurrences.

    # KB function reasoning:
    # - export_customers_csv_via_grid: exports the Customers grid, not the Orders grid. It is
    #   not applicable to this task (we need per-order statuses), so we will NOT call it.

    await asyncio.sleep(1)  # stabilize UI

    # 1) Find the status filter combobox (the one that has an option named "Canceled")
    status_comboboxes = page.get_by_role("combobox").filter(
        has=page.get_by_role("option", name=re.compile(r"Canceled", re.I))
    )
    if await status_comboboxes.count() == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("Status filter combobox with option 'Canceled' not found")

    status_combobox = status_comboboxes.first()
    # Select the 'Canceled' option
    await status_combobox.select_option(label="Canceled")

    # 2) Click the Search button to apply the filter. Scope to the parent cell to avoid ambiguity.
    search_cell = page.get_by_role("cell", name=re.compile(r"Reset Filter Search", re.I))
    if await search_cell.count() == 0:
        # fallback: a cell that contains a Search button
        search_cell = page.get_by_role("cell").filter(
            has=page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile(r"Search", re.I))
        )

    if await search_cell.count() == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("Could not locate the cell containing the Search button")

    search_button = search_cell.get_by_role("button", name="Search").first()
    if await search_button.count() == 0:
        raise RuntimeError("Search button not found inside expected cell")

    await search_button.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(1)  # wait for the grid to refresh

    # 3) Try to set per-page to 200 to minimize pagination (if available)
    per_page_comboboxes = page.get_by_role("combobox").filter(
        has=page.get_by_role("option", name=re.compile(r"200", re.I))
    )
    if await per_page_comboboxes.count() > 0:
        per_page = per_page_comboboxes.first()
        try:
            await per_page.select_option(label="200")
            # Re-apply the search to ensure the grid refreshes with the new page size
            await search_button.click()
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
        except Exception:
            # If changing page size fails, continue without failing the whole run
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    # 4) Determine total pages by reading the pagination row text (finite value)
    pagination_row = page.get_by_role("row", name=re.compile(r"Page Go to Previous page", re.I)).first()
    total_pages = 1
    try:
        if await pagination_row.count() > 0:
            text = (await pagination_row.inner_text()).strip()
            m = re.search(r"of\s+(\d+)\s+pages", text, re.I)
            if m:
                total_pages = max(1, int(m.group(1)))
    except Exception:
        total_pages = 1

    # Cap total_pages to a reasonable upper bound to avoid unexpected huge loops
    total_pages = min(total_pages, 1000)

    # 5) Iterate through pages (finite loop) and collect 'Bill to Name' values
    counts = {}

    # Scope the pagination row locator for clicking next links
    pagination_row_locator = page.get_by_role("row", name=re.compile(r"Page Go to Previous page", re.I))

    for page_index in range(1, total_pages + 1):
        # Collect order data rows by filtering rows that contain a "View" link (action cell)
        order_rows = page.get_by_role("row").filter(
            has=page.get_by_role("link", name=re.compile(r"View", re.I))
        )
        row_count = await order_rows.count()

        for i in range(row_count):
            row = order_rows.nth(i)
            cells = row.get_by_role("cell")
            if await cells.count() > 4:
                bill_to_cell = cells.nth(4)
                try:
                    name = (await bill_to_cell.inner_text()).strip()
                except Exception:
                    name = ""

                if not name:
                    name = '__unknown__'

                counts[name] = counts.get(name, 0) + 1
            else:
                # Unexpected row shape; skip
                continue

        # If this was the last page we determined, stop; otherwise try to click next
        if page_index >= total_pages:
            break

        # Find and click the 'Go to Next page' link scoped to the pagination row
        next_link = None
        if await pagination_row_locator.count() > 0:
            next_link = pagination_row_locator.get_by_role("link", name=re.compile(r"Go to Next page", re.I)).first()
        else:
            # Fallback: any page-level 'Go to Next page' link
            fallback_next = page.get_by_role("link", name=re.compile(r"Go to Next page", re.I)).first()
            if await fallback_next.count() > 0:
                next_link = fallback_next

        if next_link is None or await next_link.count() == 0:
            break

        # If the next link has no href (disabled) stop
        try:
            href = await next_link.get_attribute("href")
            if not href:
                break
        except Exception:
            # ignore and attempt to click
            pass

        await next_link.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(1)  # wait for grid to refresh

    # 6) Compute the maximum cancellations per customer and return
    max_count = max(counts.values()) if counts else 0
    print(max_count)
    return max_count

3) To reduce pagination, I attempt to set the rows-per-page combobox to '200' if present, and re-run Search to refresh the grid.

4) I read the pagination row's inner text to parse the total number of pages via the pattern 'of N pages' so I can iterate a finite number of pages (avoiding infinite loops). I cap the parsed pages to a safe upper bound.

5) I iterate from page 1 to total_pages inclusive. On each page I find order rows by filtering rows that contain a 'View' link (these are data rows). For each order row I extract the 'Bill to Name' column (the 5th data cell, index 4) and tally counts per customer.

6) After processing each page I click the 'Go to Next page' link scoped to the pagination row (if there is another page) and wait for the grid to refresh. The loop is finite because it iterates only up to total_pages.

7) Finally I compute the maximum count among customers, print it (so the harness can capture it), and return it as the result. The function avoids infinite loops and uses the accessibility tree scoping rules as required.
